query:
SELECT mo.id, mo.orderNo, mo.sellerId, mo.orderStatus, mo.sellerType, sp.id as spId, sp.userId, sp.isActive
FROM marketplaceOrders mo
LEFT JOIN sellerProfiles sp ON sp.id = mo.sellerId
ORDER BY mo.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 10;
